facts.title: Pumpkin Pineapple and Rum Cocktail
ingredients: 1 teaspoon honey or maple syrup (more or less to taste)
facts.author: Cookie and Kate

steps.text: Pour all ingredients into a blender and blend well.
Fill two double old fashioned glasses with ice.
Pour the mixture over ice and garnish with a dash of cinnamon.

notes: Recipe inspired by Pura Vida Restaurant in Cleveland, Ohio.
facts.summary: For a delicious pumpkin cocktail, blend together pumpkin purée, pineapple juice, dark rum and spices! It’s a surprising combination that tastes amazing. Recipe yields 2 drinks.
